name: Online-Fixed v1.0.5
body:
## Distribution build

Public download mirror for **online-fixed v1.0.5**. The application source and its full release notes live in the private app repository; this release exists so installed copies can check for and download builds without GitHub credentials.

| Asset | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `online-fixed_1.0.5_x64-setup.exe` | NSIS installer |
| `online-fixed_1.0.5_x64_en-US.msi` | MSI installer |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 checksums for both installers |

The in-app updater downloads the setup executable and verifies it against `SHA256SUMS.txt` before offering to run it. Keep this release public: it is the app's update feed.
